versions.subject: Improved UNC2452 activity rules
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - '7z.exe a -v500m -mx9 -r0 -p'
selection2:
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'wscript.exe'
        - '.vbs'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'rundll32.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows'
        - '.dll,Tk_'
selection3:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'C:\Windows'
    CommandLine|contains: 'cmd.exe /C '
selection4:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'rundll32 c:\windows\\'
        - '.dll '
specific1:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\dllhost.exe'
filter1:
    CommandLine: 
        - ' '
        - ''
condition: selection1 or selection2 or selection3 or selection4 or ( specific1 and not filter1 )
versions.spl: CommandLine="*7z.exe a -v500m -mx9 -r0 -p*" OR (ParentCommandLine="*wscript.exe*" ParentCommandLine="*.vbs*" CommandLine="*rundll32.exe*" CommandLine="*C:\\Windows*" CommandLine="*.dll,Tk_*") OR (ParentImage="*\\rundll32.exe" ParentCommandLine="*C:\\Windows*" CommandLine="*cmd.exe /C *") OR (CommandLine="*rundll32 c:\\windows\\*" CommandLine="*.dll *") OR (ParentImage="*\\rundll32.exe" Image="*\\dllhost.exe" NOT (CommandLine IN (" ", "")))
